_comment: Canonical shape of the curated builtin EXTRA views (#1682) — the views a kind ships beside its default (frontend builtinViews.ts synthesizes them for the switcher; backend _builtin_extra_view_spec materializes them on the first UI-state write). Roots fixed at the schema-less <kind>:base fallback, matching default-view-specs.json. Asserted by frontend builtinViews.golden.test.ts AND backend test_views.py::test_builtin_extra_view_specs_match_frontend so the two hand-written builders can't drift. Update this when an extra's shape intentionally changes.
